subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a creation-time `cron.defaults.delivery` recipient default, and should changing it leave existing persisted cron jobs untouched?
rationale: This introduces a security-sensitive configuration and recipient-selection policy; source inspection cannot choose whether operators expect future-only defaults or live retargeting of scheduled jobs.

options.title: Persist defaults only for new jobs
options.body: Add a validated cron delivery default that is copied only when creating jobs with omitted delivery, preserving existing jobs and explicit per-job routing.

options.title: Evaluate defaults at each run
options.body: Let config changes retarget jobs that still lack explicit delivery, accepting a broader operational and privacy impact.

options.title: Keep per-job routing only
options.body: Retain the current explicit channel/target workflow and decline another global recipient configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Persist defaults only for new jobs
recommendation.body: Add a validated cron delivery default that is copied only when creating jobs with omitted delivery, preserving existing jobs and explicit per-job routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded issue review already frames this as a maintainership product and security decision, rather than a narrow mechanical bug fix.
